verses.sloka: एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।भूयः समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम् ।। ५.५९.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etadākhyāya tatsarvaṁ hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।bhūyaḥ samupacakrāma vacanaṁ vaktumuttaram ।। 5.59.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, son of the Windgod having narrated in detail all that had happened again started disclosing further details৷৷
translations.hindi: सिर के बल दधिमुख को चरणों पर पड़ा देख सुग्रीव उद्विग्न हो बोले

verses.sloka: सफलो राघवोद्योगः सुग्रीवस्य च संभ्रमः ।शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्रवणं मनः ।। ५.५९.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saphalo rāghavodyogaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṁbhramaḥ ।śīlamāsādya sītāyā mama ca pravaṇaṁ manaḥ ।। 5.59.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "It is due to Rama's exertions, Sugriva's endeavour and Sita's conduct that I have been successful. My devotion to Sita has further deepened.
translations.hindi: उठो-उठो, तुम क्यों मेरे पैरों पर पड़े हुए हो । में तुम्हें भय करता हूं, 'अब जो हाल हो सो सब मुझसे कह दो

verses.sloka: तपसा धारयेल्लोकान् क्रुद्धो वा निर्दहेदपि ।सर्वथा ऽतिप्रवृद्धो ऽसौ रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।तस्य तां स्पृशतो गात्रं तपसा न विनाशितम् ।। ५.५९.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tapasā dhārayellokān kruddho vā nirdahedapi ।sarvathā 'tipravṛddho 'sau rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।tasya tāṁ spṛśato gātraṁ tapasā na vināśitam ।। 5.59.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "The demon king is rich in asceticism. He can burn the whole world with the power of his penance. In spite of Sita's anger he was not burnt(Hanuman gives the reason for Ravana's survival).

verses.sloka: न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात् संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती ।जनकस्यात्मजा कुर्याद्यत् क्रोधकलुषीकृता ।। ५.५९.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na tadagniśikhā kuryāt saṁspṛṣṭā pāṇinā satī ।janakasyātmajā kuryādyat krodhakaluṣīkṛtā ।। 5.59.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita can burn Ravana with the mere touch of her body but because of the power of his penance, he was not burnt even though he touched her hand. If enraged, Janaki can burn the whole world (by virtue of her chastity) in a way that even the flame of fire can not do. (But she desired that her husband should kill him.)
translations.hindi: हैं राजन्‌ ! आपने या वालि ने या ऋक्षराज ने पहिले जिस मघुवन को कमी ( किसी को ) इच्छानुसार भोग करने नहीं दिया--उस वन के फलों को वानरों ने खा डाला

verses.sloka: जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् सर्वाननुज्ञाप्य महाहरीन् ।अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये भवतां च निवेदिते ।। ५.५९.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavatpramukhān sarvānanujñāpya mahāharīn ।asminnevaṁgate kārye bhavatāṁ ca nivedite ।। 5.59.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.
translations.hindi: जब मेने प्रपने श्रनुचरों के साथ उनको रोका तब उन लोगों ने मेरा तिरस्कार कर इच्छानुसार मधुफल खाया श्रौर मधुपान किया

verses.sloka: न्याय्यं स्म सह वैदेह्या द्रष्टुं तौ पार्थिवात्मजौ ।। ५.५९.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nyāyyaṁ sma saha vaidehyā draṣṭuṁ tau pārthivātmajau ।। 5.59.6 ।।।।

translations.english: Having reported this matter to you and obtained leave of Jambavan and the other great vanaras, it is proper to go with Vaidehi to behold the two princes.
translations.hindi: यही नहीं, प्रत्युत जो फल खाने से बच रहे हे उन्हें वे नष्ट कर रहे हैं भ्रौर जब मेरे भ्रनुचर उन्हें मना करते हैं, तब वे भौहें टेढ़ी कर श्राँखें दिंखाते हुँ

verses.sloka: अहमेको ऽपि पर्याप्तः सराक्षसगणां पुरीम् ।तां लङ्कां तपसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम् ।। ५.५९.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahameko 'pi paryāptaḥ sarākṣasagaṇāṁ purīm ।tāṁ laṅkāṁ tapasā hantuṁ rāvaṇaṁ ca mahābalam ।। 5.59.7 ।।।।

translations.english: I alone am enough to destroy by force the city of Lanka with its demon hordes and the mighty Ravana.

verses.sloka: किं पुनः सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः ।कृतास्त्रैः प्लवगैः शूरैर्भवद्भिर्विजयैषिभिः ।। ५.५९.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ punaḥ sahito vīrairbalavadbhiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ ।kṛtāstraiḥ plavagaiḥ śūrairbhavadbhirvijayaiṣibhiḥ ।। 5.59.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "When strong, wise and accomplished persons are there with me desiring victory why speak again?

verses.sloka: अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरस्सरम् ।सहपुत्रं वधिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि ।। ५.५९.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tu rāvaṇaṁ yuddhe sasainyaṁ sapurassaram ।sahaputraṁ vadhiṣyāmi sahodarayutaṁ yudhi ।। 5.59.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "I can also kill all the army, his followers, sons and brothers of Ravana in war.

verses.sloka: ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारुणं तथा ।यदि शक्रजितो ऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्षाणि संयुगे ।। ५.५९.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: brāhmamaindraṁ ca raudraṁ ca vāyavyaṁ vāruṇaṁ tathā ।yadi śakrajito 'strāṇi durnirīkṣāṇi saṁyuge ।। 5.59.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even if the missiles used by Indrajit are Brahmastra, Indrastra, Rudrastra, Vayavastra, Varunastra which are difficult to see. I will destroy them in war and kill them.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! तुम जैसे मालिक के रहते ये सब मेरे वीर भ्रनुचर इस प्रकार मारे-पीटे गये ग्रौर प्रब भी सब वानर मधुवन में मनमानी कर खा- पी रहे हैं

verses.sloka: तान्यहं विधामिष्यामि निहनिष्यामि राक्षसान् ।भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणाद्धि तम् ।। ५.५९.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tānyahaṁ vidhāmiṣyāmi nihaniṣyāmi rākṣasān ।bhavatāmabhyanujñāto vikramo me ruṇāddhi tam ।। 5.59.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?
translations.hindi: जिस समय दघिमुख वानर कपिश्रेष्ठ सुग्रीवजी से निवेदन कर रहा था उस समय शत्रुहन्ता एवं महाप्राज्ञ लक्ष्मण ने पू छा

verses.sloka: मया ऽतुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा ।देवानपि रणे हन्यात् किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान् ।। ५.५९.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mayā 'tulā visṛṣṭā hi śailavṛṣṭirnirantarā ।devānapi raṇe hanyāt kiṁ punastānniśācarān ।। 5.59.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! यह वनपाल वानर किस लिए श्रापके पास धाया है घौर दुखी हो भापसे क्या कह रहा है ?

verses.sloka: सागरो ऽप्यतियाद्वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि ।न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी ।। ५.५९.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāgaro 'pyatiyādvelāṁ mandaraḥ pracaledapi ।na jāmbavantaṁ samare kampayedarivāhinī ।। 5.59.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The ocean may exceed its limits, the mountain Mandara may be shaken from its position but no hostile army can move Jambavan in war.
translations.hindi: नोट--जान पड़ता है दधिमुख ने सुग्रीव से वानरी भाषा में शिकायत की जिसे श्रीराम श्रौर लक्ष्मण न समझ सके । ] एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना । लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः

verses.sloka: सर्वराक्षससङ्घानां राक्षसा ये च पूर्वकाः ।अलमेको विनाशाय वीरो वालिसुतः कपिः ।। ५.५९.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvarākṣasasaṅghānāṁ rākṣasā ye ca pūrvakāḥ ।alameko vināśāya vīro vālisutaḥ kapiḥ ।। 5.59.14 ।।।।

translations.english: The heroic son of Vali, the monkey Angada, is alone enough to destroy all the hosts of demons and their forebears.
translations.hindi: हे प्रायं ! यह वीर दघिमुख वानर कह रहा है कि अ्रंगद भ्रादि वीर वानरों ने मधुवन के मधूफलों को खा डाला है

verses.sloka: पनसस्योरुवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः ।मन्दरो ऽप्यवशीर्येत किं पुनर्युधि राक्षसाः ।। ५.५९.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: panasasyoruvegena nīlasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।mandaro 'pyavaśīryeta kiṁ punaryudhi rākṣasāḥ ।। 5.59.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even the mountain Mandara would be shattered by great Panasa or Nila by the speed of their thighs. What to say in a battle against ogres?
translations.hindi: इससे जान पड़ता है कि दक्षिण दिशा में सीताजी का पता लगा वे यानरश्रेष्ठ प्रा गए हूँ क्योंकि बिना कार्य पूरा किए वे ऐसी ढिठाई नहीं कर सकते थे

verses.sloka: सदेवासुरयक्षेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु ।मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा ।। ५.५९.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sadevāsurayakṣeṣu gandharvoragapakṣiṣu ।maindasya pratiyoddhāraṁ śaṁsata dvividasya vā ।। 5.59.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "Who among gods, yakshas, gandharvas, nagas and birds can contend Mainda or Dvivida in battle?Tell me.
translations.hindi: प्राकर समस्त वन को नष्ट करना श्रोर मना करने पर मना करने चालों को मारना-पीटना तथा मघुफलों को खाना--यह सव वे तभी कर सकते हँ जब वे पने कार्य को पूरा कर चुके हों

verses.sloka: अश्विपुत्रौ महाभागावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ ।एतयोः प्रतियोद्धारं न पश्यामि रणाजिरे ।। ५.५९.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśviputrau mahābhāgāvetau plavagasattamau ।etayoḥ pratiyoddhāraṁ na paśyāmi raṇājire ।। 5.59.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "The (two) sons of Aswini are outstanding and foremost fighters and proud of waging war. Who can oppose them? I do not see any one.
translations.hindi: यदि उन वानरों ने वन में श्राकर उपद्रव किया है तो निश्चय ही बे लोग श्रौर विशेष कर हनुमान सीता को देख प्राए हें

verses.sloka: पितामहवरोत्सेकात् परमं दर्पमास्थितौ ।अमृतप्राशिनावेतौ सर्ववानरसत्तमौ ।। ५.५९.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pitāmahavarotsekāt paramaṁ darpamāsthitau ।amṛtaprāśināvetau sarvavānarasattamau ।। 5.59.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "By virtue of the boons received from Brahma, they are very proud. They have also consumed nectar of immortality and are foremost among vanaras.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हनुमान को छोड़, यह काम दूसरा नहीं कर सकता हनुमानजी में कार्य पुरा करने की बुद्धि है

verses.sloka: अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः ।सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान् पुरा ।। ५.५९.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśvinormānanārthaṁ hi sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ।sarvāvadhyatvamatulamanayordattavān purā ।। 5.59.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier Brahma, the grandsire of all worlds has given the Aswini sons immeasurable invulnerability to honour them.

verses.sloka: करोत्सेकेन मुक्तौ च प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम् ।सुराणाममृतं वीरौ पीतवन्तौ प्लवङ्गमौ ।। ५.५९.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: karotsekena muktau ca pramathya mahatīṁ camūm ।surāṇāmamṛtaṁ vīrau pītavantau plavaṅgamau ।। 5.59.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "The heroic monkeys, proud of their boons became intoxicated it and slaughtered vast army and drank the nectar of immortality.
translations.hindi: उपयुक्तं-मुक्तं । (रा०) ५४४ सुन्दरकाण्डे मरौर जिस काम के हनुमानजी ग्रधिष्ठाता हों वहाँ पर कोई काथं अघूरा नहीं रह सकता । इससे प्रंगदप्रमुख वीर वानरों ने मधुवन को नष्ट कर डाला है

verses.sloka: एतावेव हि संक्रुद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् ।लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः ।। ५.५९.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etāveva hi saṁkruddhau savājirathakuñjarām ।laṅkāṁ nāśayituṁ śaktau sarve tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ ।। 5.59.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "If these two become angry they have the power to destroy Lanka, the cavalry, chariots and also the elephants even if the vanaras stay away.
translations.hindi: आर मना करने पर मना करने वालों को लातों से मारा है। ये ही बातें कहने के लिए यह मघुरभाषी वानर मेरे पास आया है

verses.sloka: मयैव निहता लङ्कां दग्धा भस्मीकृता पुनः ।राजमार्गेषु सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया ।। ५.५९.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mayaiva nihatā laṅkāṁ dagdhā bhasmīkṛtā punaḥ ।rājamārgeṣu sarvatra nāma viśrāvitaṁ mayā ।। 5.59.22 ।।।।

translations.english: "I have burnt Lanka and have made my name popular even on the highways.
translations.hindi: इनका नाम दधिमुख वानर है श्रौर यह एक प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी है) हे महाबाहु लक्ष्मण ! देखो वास्तव में बात यह है कि, उन लोगों ने सीता का पता लगा लिया है

verses.sloka: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ।राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ।। ५.५९.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jayatyatibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ ।। 5.59.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.
translations.hindi: तभी तो वे सब वानर आकर मधुपान कर रहे हैं । हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! बिना सौता को देखे वे विख्यात वानर लोग

verses.sloka: अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः ।हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया ।। ५.५९.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ kosalarājasya dāsaḥ pavanasambhavaḥ ।hanumāniti sarvatra nāma viśrāvitaṁ mayā ।। 5.59.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.
translations.hindi: देवताओं के द्वारा प्राप्त दिव्य मधुवन को कमी उजाड़ नहीं सकते थे) तब तो धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ग्रौर लक्ष्मणजी बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।अधस्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता ।। ५.५९.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāmadhye rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।adhastācchiṁśupāvṛkṣe sādhvī karuṇamāsthitā ।। 5.59.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.
translations.hindi: सुग्रीव के मुख से इस सुखसंवाद को सुन, महाबलवान श्रीरामचन्द्रजी शोर लक्ष्मणजी बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसन्तापकर्शिता ।मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा ।अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम् ।। ५.५९.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasībhiḥ parivṛtā śokasantāpakarśitā ।meghalekhāparivṛtā candralekheva niṣprabhā ।acintayantī vaidehī rāvaṇaṁ baladarpitam ।। 5.59.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.
translations.hindi: दधिमुख के मुख से इस संवाद को सुन सुग्रीव प्रसन्न होकर उस वनरक्षक दघिमुख से बोले

verses.sloka: पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी ।। ५.५९.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: pativratā ca suśroṇī avaṣṭabdhā ca jānakī ।। 5.59.27 ।।

translations.english: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.
translations.hindi: में उन कृतकर्मा वानरों द्वारा मधुफलों के खाए जाने से प्रसन्न हूँ क्योंकि उन्होंने बड़ा भारी काम किया है श्रतः उन्होंने जो धृष्टता श्रथवा उत्पात किए हैं वे क्षन्तव्य हे

verses.sloka: वृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा ।अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा ।अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे ।। ५.५९.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vṛtā candralekheva niṣprabhā ।anuraktā hi vaidehī rāmaṁ sarvātmanā śubhā ।ananyacittā rāme ca paulomīva purandare ।। 5.59.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.
translations.hindi: उन सिंह समान पराक्रमी तथा कृतकर्मा हनुमानादि वानरों को म॑ शीघ्र देखना चाहता हूँ श्रौर श्रीरामचन्द्र तथा लक्ष्मण सहित में सीताजी के पास उनके पहुँचने का वृत्तान्त सुनना चाहता हूँ

verses.sloka: तदेकवासः संवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च ।शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी सीता भर्तृहिते रता ।। ५.५९.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadekavāsaḥ saṁvītā rajodhvastā tathaiva ca ।śokasantāpadīnāṅgī sītā bhartṛhite ratā ।। 5.59.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "Wearing the same single cloth which she had worn before, filled with dust, Sita remained sorrowful and piteous wishing her husband's welfare.

verses.sloka: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ।राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने ।। ५.५९.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā mayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।rākṣasībhirvirūpābhirdṛṣṭā hi pramadāvane ।। 5.59.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

verses.sloka: एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा ।अधः शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे ।। ५.५९.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā ।adhaḥ śayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame ।। 5.59.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

verses.sloka: रावणाद् विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया ।कथंचिन्मृगशावाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता ।। ५.५९.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇād vinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā ।kathaṁcinmṛgaśāvākṣī viśvāsamupapāditā ।। 5.59.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

verses.sloka: ततः सम्भाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता ।रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ।। ५.५९.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sambhāṣitā caiva sarvamarthaṁ ca darśitā ।rāmasugrīvasakhyaṁ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā ।। 5.59.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

verses.sloka: नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा ।यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं स महात्मा कृतागसम् ।निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति ।। ५.५९.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktirbhartari cottamā ।yanna hanti daśagrīvaṁ sa mahātmā kṛtāgasam ।nimittamātraṁ rāmastu vadhe tasya bhaviṣyati ।। 5.59.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)

verses.sloka: सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता ।प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुतां गता ।। ५.५९.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā prakṛtyaiva tanvaṅgī tadviyogācca karśitā ।pratipatpāṭhaśīlasya vidyeva tanutāṁ gatā ।। 5.59.35 ।।।।

translations.english: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).

verses.sloka: एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा ।यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपद्यताम् ।। ५.५९.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamāste mahābhāgā sītā śokaparāyaṇā ।yadatra pratikartavyaṁ tatsarvamupapadyatām ।। 5.59.36 ।।

translations.english: "Noble Sita is absorbed in grief. Let us do all that has to be done now." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
